description: Two RIOB18 tiles of an xc7z030 HP bank: an input on IOB_Y0 with an output on IOB_Y1, and an output at 16 mA
exercises: an LVCMOS18 output at the default drive on an HP bank (the drive row of each strength)
an input on IOB_Y0 of an HP tile (zynq7 has only the long input names)
an input on IOB_Y0 with IOB_Y1 in use (no pulldown on a used half)
an LVCMOS18 output at DRIVE 16 on an HP bank
why: Each LVCMOS12/15/18 drive strength on an HP (RIOB18) bank is a code of its own. Release 2026-10-14 writes the 12 mA code for every strength under a grouped name, and stops fasm2frames on the first tile here: LVCMOS18.DRIVE.I12_I8 is in no RIOB18 database, IOB_Y0.LVCMOS12_LVCMOS15.IN is not in zynq7's, and the input gives the used IOB_Y1 a PULLTYPE.PULLDOWN that clears its PULLTYPE.NONE. The second tile, an output at DRIVE 16, assembles with the 12 mA code. openXC7/nextpnr#106 with the rows of prjxray-db#36 writes what Vivado writes for both tiles.
